name: Cube Camera Volumetric Shadows
definition: A method to cast volumetric shadows in all directions from a single light source by using a CubeCamera to capture depth from six directions, overcoming the limitation of a single directional light camera.
summary: Cube Camera Volumetric Shadows cast volumetric shadows in all directions from a single light source using a CubeCamera, overcoming single-direction limitations despite being a lower-quality hack.
